message.text: Plan the synthetic Harbor webhook platform migration. Inspect our system, calculate average daily payload volume and peak consumer capacity with 50% headroom. Compare PostgreSQL outbox consumers with adopting Kafka. Recommend a staged architecture; identify what cannot be costed yet.
